scientific_integrity: Analytical proof and independently implemented exact finite arithmetic checks; computational tests corroborate but do not prove the universal statements. The cited 2009 paper is prior foundational ANOVA decomposition, not presented as authorship or priority for the new sharp envelope.
scientific_limitations: Finite real product spaces, strictly positive masses and the full endpoint maximum norm. No correlated measures, arbitrary interaction masks, or general Lp norms; uniqueness of marginal minimizers and attainment of the positive-mass global supremum are not claimed. Literature comparisons leave residual historical equivalence risk.
title: Sharp endpoint stability envelopes for finite-order ANOVA projections
